title: Rosemary Beach "The Beach House" 106 Rosemary Avenue
h1: Rosemary Beach "The Beach House" 106 Rosemary Avenue
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf Views- Screened-in porch- 3 Adult Bikes- Fitness room- Short Walk to the Beach- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Elevated coastal comfort awaits at The Beach House in Rosemary Beach, a 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home that sleeps 9 guests. Enjoy access to community pools, wander the local boutiques for unique souvenirs, or visit Camp Helen State Park for paddleboarding and kayaking on Lake Powell. Guests will love spending carefree days unwinding on the covered porches, or strolling to the beach—only a 1-minute walk away!The first level of this 2-story home hosts a collection of well-appointed sleeping accommodations, beginning with a comfy twin bed nestled beneath the stairs. The first guest bedroom features a queen bed, while the second bedroom includes a king bed and a living area with a queen sleeper sofa. Outside, find a delightful brick patio with Adirondack lounge chairs.Upstairs, warm hardwood floors add warmth to the cool, sea-inspired aesthetic of the second-level great room. Curl up with a good book and a glass of wine on the 2 slip-covered sofas and 2 boucle barrel armchairs in the living area. A wall-mounted TV offers entertainment, while 2 armchairs to the side provide additional seating. Stunning floor-to-ceiling windows in the corner dining space create a solarium-style experience at the 6-person table. The chef of the group will love the kitchen’s quartz countertops, breakfast bar for 2, and Thermador stove. Through the living area’s French doors, discover a wraparound porch boasting cushioned wicker furniture, a hanging swing, and an alfresco 6-seat table—the ultimate spot for sipping iced tea in the balmy breeze. A staircase leads past a barbecue grill to the furnished screened-in pavilion with a wet bar, TV, and ceiling fans.A cozy living space, complete with a wet bar, beverage fridge, couch, and TV, awaits on the top level and leads onto a covered porch with peek-a-boo water views. Off the living space is the beautiful primary bedroom featuring a king bed and private bathroom, as well as a charming sunroom with plush furnishings.Experience a delightful Rosemary Beach vacation at The Beach House! On-site parking and 3 complimentary adult bikes make it easy to explore. For the nearest beach access, turn right onto Rosemary Avenue, take another right onto East Water Street, and follow the beach walkover on the left near the bend in the road. Book today! Guests also have access to 4 or Rosemary's incredible pools, including the Coquina Pool, the Sky Pool, the Barbados Pool and the Cabana Pool. Five adult bikes are on hand to whisk you go and from the beach, amenities, and all of the wonderful shopping and dining opportunities. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 9):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin Bed in HallwayTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Media Space and Wet Bar*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and management fines.*It is possible that your rental property may share a courtyard or lot with a carriage house or main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party.

Enjoy access to community pools, wander the local boutiques for unique souvenirs, or visit Camp Helen State Park for paddleboarding and kayaking on Lake Powell. Guests will love spending carefree days unwinding on the covered porches, or strolling to the beach—only a 1-minute walk away! The first level of this 2-story home hosts a collection of well-appointed sleeping accommodations, beginning with a comfy twin bed nestled beneath the stairs. The first guest bedroom features a queen bed, while the second bedroom includes a king bed and a living area with a queen sleeper sofa. Outside, find a delightful brick patio with Adirondack lounge chairs. Upstairs, warm hardwood floors add warmth to the cool, sea-inspired aesthetic of the second-level great room. Through the living area’s French doors, discover a wraparound porch boasting cushioned wicker furniture, a hanging swing, and an alfresco 6-seat table—the ultimate spot for sipping iced tea in the balmy breeze. A staircase leads past a barbecue grill to the furnished screened-in pavilion with a wet bar, TV, and ceiling fans. A cozy living space, complete with a wet bar, beverage fridge, couch, and TV, awaits on the top level and leads onto a covered porch with peek-a-boo water views. Off the living space is the beautiful primary bedroom featuring a king bed and private bathroom, as well as a charming sunroom with plush furnishings. Experience a delightful Rosemary Beach vacation at The Beach House! On-site parking and 3 complimentary adult bikes make it easy to explore. For the nearest beach access, turn right onto Rosemary Avenue, take another right onto East Water Street, and follow the beach walkover on the left near the bend in the road. Book today! Guests also have access to 4 or Rosemary's incredible pools, including the Coquina Pool, the Sky Pool, the Barbados Pool and the Cabana Pool. Five adult bikes are on hand to whisk you go and from the beach, amenities, and all of the wonderful shopping and dining opportunities.
